mapper.select:
with a AS ( select to_char(updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as updateDate, count(*) as count, nvl(sum(price * quantity), 0) as sumPrice, nvl(avg(price * quantity), 0) as avgPrice from orderdetail where 1 = 1 and state not in(1, 2, 3) and updateDate between add_months(sysdate, -5) and sysdate group by to_char(updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ), b AS ( select to_date(to_char(sysdate + 1 - level, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as three_m from dual connect by level < sysdate - add_months(sysdate, -5) + 1 order by three_m )
select to_date(to_char(three_m, 'MM'), 'MM') as month, nvl(sum(a.count), 0) as count, nvl(sum(a.sumPrice), 0) as sumPrice, trunc(nvl(avg(a.avgPrice), 0), 0) as avgPrice from a right outer join b on a.updateDate = b.three_m group by to_date(to_char(b.three_m, 'MM'), 'MM') order by to_date(to_char(b.three_m, 'MM'), 'MM')

select to_date(to_char(three_m, 'YYYY-MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as month, a.category as category, nvl(sum(a.cnt), 0) as count, nvl(round(ratio_to_report(sum(a.cnt)) over() * 100, 1), 0) as percent from ( select to_char(d.updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as updateDate, i.category, count(*) as cnt, round(ratio_to_report(sum(i.cnt)) over() * 100, 1) as percent from ( select ino, category AS category, count(*) AS cnt from item group by ino, category ) i, orderdetail d where 1 = 1 and i.ino = d.ino and d.state = 4 and d.updateDate between trunc(sysdate, 'MM') and sysdate group by to_char(d.updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), i.category ) a right outer join ( select to_date(to_char(sysdate + 1 - level, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as three_m from dual connect by level < sysdate - trunc(sysdate, 'MM') + 1 order by three_m ) b on b.three_m = a.updateDate where 1 = 1 group by to_date(to_char(b.three_m, 'YYYY-MM'), 'YYYY-MM'), a.category order by a.category

with a AS ( select nvl(sum(price * quantity), 0) as totalPrice from orderdetail where 1 = 1 and state = 4 ), b AS ( select nvl(sum(price * quantity), 0) as monthPrice from orderdetail where 1 = 1 and updateDate between trunc(sysdate, 'MM') and sysdate and state = 4 ), c AS ( select nvl(max(visitCount), 0) as visitCount from visit where 1 = 1 and to_char(visitDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ), d AS ( select count(*) as regDateCount from member where 1 = 1 and to_char(regDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char(sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
select totalPrice, monthPrice, visitCount, regDateCount from a, b, c, d

select m.id, to_char(m.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regdate, m.point, m.role, (select count(*) from board where id = m.id) as boardCount, (select count(*) from reply where id = m.id) as replyCount, (select count(*) from orderdetail where id = m.id) as orderCount from member m where 1 = 1 /* and not m.role = (upper('admin')) */

select d.oino as oino, d.orderId as orderId, d.id as id, d.ino as ino, i.name as name, d.price as price, d.quantity as quantity, d.state as state, d.regDate as regDate, d.updateDate as updateDate from item i, orderDetail d where 1 = 1 and i.ino = d.ino and not d.state = 4
